name: Loan EMI Calculator
description: Work out your monthly loan payment, total interest and year-by-year balance, and see how an extra monthly payment shortens the loan.
facts: Calculates the monthly payment (EMI) from the loan amount, the yearly interest rate and the term in years or months
Shows total interest, total payment, the number of payments needed and a year by year table of principal, interest and balance
Lets you add an extra monthly payment and shows the interest saved and the months saved
Uses the standard reducing balance formula with monthly compounding; a rate of 0 splits the loan evenly
Accepts terms from 1 month up to 50 years and rates from 0 to 100 percent
Can show numbers in the international style or the lakh and crore style used in South Asia
Works with any currency because it only does the arithmetic and does not convert money
Runs entirely in the browser; the figures you enter are never uploaded or stored
limits: Results are estimates; a lender may add fees, insurance or a different rounding rule
Rates that change over time, such as floating rates, are not modeled
Payment dates are not modeled, so the schedule assumes equal monthly periods
use_cases: planning a car or home loan
checking the effect of paying extra each month
